caption: The video captures a wide-angle beach scene where two black wand poles, each marked with a teal band, rise from the left and right edges, joined by strings that hold a large iridescent soap film. The film begins as a broad, sagging pouch, streaked with shifting pinks, magentas, greens and yellows around a dark central reflection of the hillside. Later, the poles are drawn toward the center, the left tip moving rightward and the right tip leftward, narrowing the string loop into a more vertical V. The soap film deforms in response, becoming a slimmer sheet while its rainbow swirls reorganize around the reflective core. A bright gold sheen appears along the lower left pole as its angle catches the light. Meanwhile, the background buildings shift slightly, suggesting a small camera movement. The film remains intact, with no pop or release.
